what: At the center of a background-color curtain, 24 accent tiles (130×60, based on window width 1600) gather in one vertical column (8 rows, row spacing 72) (.46s power3.inOut, .006 apart from the center), then form the numbers 3 → 2 → 1 in a 3-column × 8-row grid — for each number they move over .36s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1) in random order .004 apart, resting 90ms. When the page has fully loaded (at least one round), tiles gather from the outermost toward the center (.46s) leaving only the first, which grows over 1.96s power4.inOut to the target (top band) size and position and becomes a surface, and the curtain lifts over .82s starting at 1.52s. fx:assemble fires when gathering starts and fx:done when it ends — the rest of the Hero’s entrances are hung with fx:assemble set to 0 seconds.

options.until: load (default, window load) or the name of a window event to wait for (goes ahead anyway after 9s)
options.target: Target css that the grown tiles cover (top strip of the screen if none)
options.loops: Minimum number of laps to count (3·2·1), default 1
options.delay: Delay before tiles appear (seconds), default 0 — in the original the heading fades in first at .7s, then
options.count: Number shift duration (s), default .36 · hold pause between numbers (ms), default 90
options.gather: Gathering duration (sec), default .46 · for grow, unfolding duration (sec), default 1.96
options.tile: Tile width (px), default 130 · tile-h height 60 · col column gap 144 · row row gap 72
options.base: Reference width in numbers, default 1600 (scales .64 to 1.6× with window width) — 0 keeps px as is

note: Original phone: tile 83.2×38.4 · gap × .64 — on phone, tile: 83.2; Set tile-h: 38.4 and base to 402 to match

from.where: index.html hero opening (original yl: fl number table, dl 130/144/72, .46, .36, 90ms, 1.96 power4.inOut)
